# Zsh / Oh My Zsh

This mod adds zsh and Oh My Zsh to code-server/openvscode-server, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-zsh
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-zsh|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

`Oh My Zsh` is installed at `/config/.oh-my-zsh` and can be updated via `omz update` in terminal.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-zsh/
